_readme: Evidence register for the 2026-10-15 'real data sources' audit & repair. Every claim below is either (a) captured from production/ providers during the audit window, (b) reproduced by an automated test in this repo, or (c) explicitly labeled as unverifiable from the audit environment. No secrets are recorded — only environment-variable names.
auditEnvironmentLimitation: Sandbox egress was degraded after ~05:33Z (page-fetch proxy returned SignatureDoesNotMatch, direct HTTP blocked), so live XML from publisher feeds could NOT be re-verified from this environment. Feed existence was corroborated from third-party feed indexes captured earlier the same day; parsing/validation behavior is proven offline by tests/publisher-rss-news.test.ts.

publisher-rss.why: Google News RSS relays made 100% of production news links unresolvable (resolved: 0). A direct publisher-feed source removes the dependency for real article URLs.
publisher-rss.evidence: Feed URLs corroborated via feeder.co knowledge base (BBC arabic feed active, ~12 posts/day at check time) and Feedtop Egyptian-news index listing FilGoal, captured 2026-10-15 audit session. Live XML not re-verifiable from audit sandbox (labeled honestly in seed status 'degraded' until first live sync).

google-news-rss: 11 localized feed queries (ar/EG core + club/competition queries)

B_egyptianLeagueEvidence.providerSupport: VERIFIED live during audit: thesportsdb.com lookupleague id=4829 → 'Egyptian Premier League', strCurrentSeason 2026-2027, idAPIfootball 8636 (fetched 2026-10-15 ~05:2xZ). eventsnextleague 4829 → fixture 2561130 'El Gouna vs Smouha' 2026-10-19T14:00Z intRound 7 status NS.
B_egyptianLeagueEvidence.production: GET /api/matches?date=2026-10-19 (prod, 2026-10-15T05:28Z) returned 2 Egyptian Premier League Round-7 matches (Smouha–Ceramica Cleopatra 14:00Z, Enppi–Pyramids 17:00Z; tsdb ids 2561130/2561131). 2026-10-15 itself: 53 matches stored, 0 Egyptian — legitimate: no EPL matchday that day. Cairo-time labels verified (14:00Z → ٥ م).
B_egyptianLeagueEvidence.note: The requirement 'real Egyptian Premier League fixtures visible' was ALREADY met on production before this repair; this audit preserved it (routes/slugs untouched) and hardened dedup + cold-start retry around it.

C_newsEvidence.rootCause: All Google News RSS article links are relay URLs (https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi…?oc=5) whose payload is now an opaque AU_yqL token. Recorded live sample (3 items, feed captured 2026-10-15T05:31Z) → decodeGoogleNewsArticleToken resolves 0/3 offline; production /api/health showed resolutionReport 10 attempted / 0 resolved with error interstitial_without_destination (05:00:53Z). Hence 'connected but 0 published' — the app honestly rejected every item.
C_newsEvidence.fixture: tests/fixtures/google-news/rss-live-relay-tokens-2026-10-15.json (recorded, not mocked) + test A1 in tests/publisher-rss-news.test.ts reproduces this offline, no network needed.
repair: New source publisher-rss ingests DIRECT publisher-article URLs (registrable-domain gate per feed; Google-relay and off-domain links rejected and counted).
Engine runs publisher first; Google relay items then dedup onto the same canonical record by URL — verified by test C1 (story arriving through both sources exists exactly once).

Resolver hardened: AF_initDataCallback accepted under any ds:N index; batchexecute fallback scans the first bare quoted https URL (Google hosts refused) — tests E1/E2. Failure diagnostics (e.g. relay_params_not_found) surface in ResolutionReport.errorNotes without changing stable error codes.

Cron /api/cron/sync-news now reports an aggregate status derived from store delta + both source records, so a Google-only outage with working publisher feeds no longer reports degraded with 0 published.

Cold-start flake fixed: /api/health 2026-10-15T05:00:53Z showed news/matches 'fetch failed' at 12–78ms (egress race on a cold instance) — request-path fetches now retry once on instant network errors only (retryOnNetworkErrorOnly), never on timeouts — test E3.
C_newsEvidence.eachArticleOnce: processNewsBatch URL-normalization dedup is shared by both sources; publisher runs first so relay duplicates merge into 'updated'. Tests C1 (cross-source single card) and C2 (idempotent re-run: identical counts, no duplicate links).

D_dedupEvidence.matches: upsertMatchesInStoreWithStats + compareFixtureIdentity gates unchanged (no deletions, no aggressive merging). Regression suite 'fixture-duplicate-guard' green.
D_dedupEvidence.teamSwapBug: FOUND & FIXED: production event id 2561130 carried 'Smouha vs Ceramica' while the provider had re-published the same id for 'El Gouna vs Smouha' (schedule re-assignment). mergeMatchRecords ignored team changes on newer data. New guarded adoption: only when the existing record is newer-null (not_started AND no score) and the incoming teams are real, and only from a NEWER provider observation; finished/live/postponed/cancelled records are never re-tagged. Tests D1/D2.
D_dedupEvidence.news: Rejected/failed Google items never publish; published cards carry publisher URLs only (test C1 asserts no news.google.com link on any published card).

E_otherFixes: Snapshot upgrade path: migrateGatewayDatabase now backfills source definitions added by upgrades (e.g. publisher-rss) into long-running snapshots, so /api/sources and status recording see new sources without a full rebuild.

fetchWithProtection retryOnNetworkErrorOnly plumbed into sportscore, thesportsdb (incl. key probe), google-news-rss and publisher-rss; fetchWithCache single-shot semantics preserved for existing tests.
publisher-rss per-feed time budget (budgetMs) so a hung feed cannot stall the news cycle.
Admin/registry wiring: capability matrix, priority (85), display name ('خلاصات الناشرين المباشرة'), env description, per-key documentation.

F_testResults.after: 305/305 passing (289 + 16 new in tests/publisher-rss-news.test.ts); one existing assertion updated legitimately: gateway.test #6 now expects 6 seeded sources.
F_testResults.lint: eslint lib app scripts tests --max-warnings=0 — clean
F_testResults.build: npm run build (Next 16) — clean; all existing routes unchanged (no route/slug/URL modifications).
F_testResults.offlineRootCauseProof: node --import tsx scripts/audit-connectivity.ts in a network-starved sandbox: every live probe honestly 'fetch failed', googleRelayLinksDecodableOffline {captured:3, decodable:0} — exit code 1 (unhealthy) as designed. On a machine with egress, this command verifies all six sources live and writes docs/evidence/connectivity.json with --out=.

modified: lib/sync/engine.ts (two-source news orchestration, ensureFreshNews gate + quick bounded retries)
lib/sources/sportscore.ts / thesportsdb.ts / google-news-rss.ts (retry flag; errorNotes diagnostics)
lib/news/google-news-resolver.ts (ds:N params, quoted-URL fallback, failure detail)
lib/db/seed-data.ts (publisher-rss seed entry; buildSeedSourceDefinitions; guarded team-swap adoption)
lib/types.ts / lib/sources/types.ts / lib/sources/priority.ts / lib/news/capabilities.ts / lib/admin/manual-document.ts / lib/catalog.ts / lib/config/env.ts (registry wiring)

H_blockers: Live publisher-feed XML could not be re-fetched from the audit environment (egress proxy SignatureDoesNotMatch after ~05:33Z). Owner should run `npm run audit:connectivity` with network to convert the seed 'degraded' status to live-verified.

Google News RSS terms restrict usage to personal purposes; the new publisher-direct source is the compliant primary path going forward (Google feed kept as best-effort enrichment with honest rejection).

Production store durability: snapshots in /tmp are per-instance (observed totalInStore 37 vs 133 across instances during the audit) — configuring a durable backend (README §storage) remains the owner's deployment decision; no DB migration was attempted.

I_deployment.note: Work is on branch arena/0f39ac06-nemo-live-kora. No merge to production, no Vercel deploy, no changes to the external cron service or streaming engine — per audit constraints. Production behavior after merge will show the sixth source in /api/sources and cron /api/cron/sync-news aggregate status automatically.
